permission_basis.note: SIL OFL 1.1 as shipped at ofl/intertight/OFL.txt in google/fonts at the pinned commit. The upstream copyright notice specifies no Reserved Font Name, so the OFL rename restriction does not apply.

license.note: The in-tree licence text is a whitespace-normalised copy of this file, not a byte-identical one. Its own SHA-256 is recorded in docs/brand/wordmark-inter-tight-600.json as sourceLicenseSha256.

planned_transformations: Instance the variable font at weight 600.
Subset to basic Latin and emit WOFF2.
Convert the lowercase 'skilit' letter outlines to immutable SVG path geometry, tracked in docs/brand/wordmark-inter-tight-600.json.
Serve the licence text beside the font at /brand/Inter-Tight-OFL.txt and link it from the legal terms surface.

known_limitations: The subsetting tool and its version are not recorded, so the upstream-TTF-to-WOFF2 derivation is asserted by digest rather than reproducible offline.
Only the CSS alias is renamed. The WOFF2 binary retains the upstream name identifiers and carries the copyright notice but no embedded licence description or URL.
